verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.galileo.ai/llms.txt that indexes a 198-page documentation bundle. Docs pages are also served as markdown (.md), and each one points agents back to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party guide describing how to use llms.txt with agents, and no independent reports of agents actually consuming it.
